notes.title: Issues with Missing Save Files or Game Launching
notes.content:
[h1]Guo, here.[/h1]

I have been notified about a two issues regarding EOS 27. These issues should not impact new players, but may impact existing ones:

[u][b][h3]Executable Error on Game Launch[/h3][/b][/u]
First, some people have been receiving an error upon launching the game. 

Here is a potential fix:
Right Click on EOS 27 in your library --> Click [b]Properties...[/b] --> [b]Local Files[/b] --> [b]Verify integrity of game files...[/b]

This should allow you to launch your game again.

[u][b]
[h3]Save Files Have "Disappeared"[/h3][/b][/u]
Secondly, some have been reporting that their save files are no longer appearing in-game. Don't worry, they aren't permanently removed, but rather are hiding somewhere in the files due to an error on our part. 

Here's what to do to retrieve your save:
Right Click on EOS 27 in your library --> Click [b]Properties...[/b] -->[b] Local Files[/b] --> [b]Browse...[/b]
In the game files, you should see either a folder named [b]WindowsNoEditor[/b] or [b]Eos27SaveFix[/b].

Here's what to do next in your game files:
[olist]
[*] Open either folder WindowsNoEditor or Eos27SaveFix, whichever is there.
[*] Locate the folder named [b]Saved[/b]
[*] Copy the [b]Saved[/b] folder.
[*] Go back to the main game files area (exit the WindowsNoEditor/Eos27SaveFix folder).
[*] Paste the [b]Saved[/b] folder into your main game files area. Say yes to replacing any files named that.
[/olist]

Your save file should now appear in-game.


[h3]If these fixes do not work for you and you do not mind restarting your progress, we have found that [b]reinstalling the game[/b] clears the game of issues, [b]but does not retain your progress[/b].[/h3]


We hope that these fixes work for you. If they do not, please send me an email at [u]developerjjg@gmail.com[/u]. We take full responsibility for these issues, for they were due to poor practices on our part, and sincerely apologize if they have interrupted your experience playing. We completely understand why this issue has arisen and will make sure that this issue will never appear again in future updates.

Again, we deeply apologize if your experience playing EOS 27 has been interrupted by these issues.

notes.title: Release Update: 1.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]Guo checking in![/h1]

Here are some bug fixes and minor changes to EOS 27:


[u]v.1.0.0 Bug Fixes:[/u]
- Hitboxes on mobs that were not meant to be visible are now hidden.
- The player no longer spawns with an IrAM chip upon first loading the game.
- The player can no longer enter the mole miniboss arena after having beaten it already.
- Main Menu no longer says the version is Closed Beta v.0.1 or whatever it was.



[u]v.1.0.0 Gameplay Changes (Spoilers marked): [/u]
- Added arrows to guide players to the house after beating the mole miniboss. [i](Sorry to all you guys who thought the game ended after beating the mole! I swear my game is longer than 12 minutes!)[/i]
- [spoiler]The final cutscene can now be replayed: The generator in the final arena will now always be destructible.[/spoiler]



That's all for this update. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h1]This is Guo, checking in![/h1]

Today, [b]EOS 27[/b] has officially released on the Steam Store. I hope that all of you have fun playing!

Here are some known bugs about the game. I'll work to have these fixed in the next patch. (Spoilers tagged):
 - The game says it's in version v0.1. Oops. I must have forgotten to change that text.
 - Immediately after defeating the mole boss, going to its arena again will cause its fight to repeat.
 - Debugging Hitboxes on some mobs are visible.
 - [spoiler] After beating the final boss a second time, the generator will not respawn, preventing you from initiating the end sequence / cutscene. [/spoiler]

As more bugs are discovered, they will be documented and fixed accordingly. If you have any comments or suggestions about the game or have a bug to report, shoot me an email at [u]developerjjg@gmail.com[/u]. Your feedback is very, very much appreciated.

Most importantly, have fun playing! :D
